description: Prepares a document for external distribution or e-signature. Note: in this zero-dependency environment, protection_mode='encrypt' is unsupported and falls back to a native read-only lock; export_pdf and password are ignored. [Adeu v3.0.6+df9e00c]

accept_all.description: If true, auto-accepts all unresolved track changes before finalizing.

author.description: Replace all remaining markup authorship with this name.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the DOCX file.

protection_mode.description: Native OOXML document locking. Note: 'encrypt' is unsupported in this zero-dependency build and falls back to 'read_only'.

reasoning.description: Why do I need to finalize this document? State this reason before any other parameter.

sanitize_mode.description: full removes all markup, keep-markup redacts metadata.

name: finalize_document
